purpose: Compare existing SkyJEPA with a separate JEPA-Anything OPF UAV adaptation and render a synchronized comparison video, regardless of winner.
scope: Single-training-seed engineering comparison; no claim of paper reproduction or broad superiority.

opf.backbone: same TCN encoders and GRU widths as SkyJEPA; independent linear factor outputs with shared recurrent trunk
opf.orthogonality: QR retraction after every optimizer step

prober.implementation: same native frozen-latent physics prober trainer

video.selection: fixed seed, never select footage by winner
video.format: 1080p side-by-side replay of recorded simulated trajectories at 1x, with numerical error and aggregate results

limitations: Additional OPF parameters and EMA objective differ from SkyJEPA; this compares complete adaptations and does not isolate factorization.
Python is used for experimental latent training/export; inference, prober training, planning and evaluation remain native Rust/CUDA.
Historical SkyJEPA training is reused; fresh control comparisons use the same executable on the same GPU without overlapping this experiment's training.
